PM Modi Inaugurates Bhogapuram Airport, Launches Projects in Andhra Pradesh

Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram, Andhra Pradesh. The airport is the state's first greenfield international airport since its bifurcation in 2014. During the event, PM Modi also laid the foundation stones for projects worth approximately ₹17,900 crore across the state. The new airport is expected to boost connectivity, trade, and regional growth in North Coastal Andhra Pradesh. Separately, Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, leader of the opposition, accused Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu of appropriating credit for the airport project.
